children: Kura formed Caspian Therapeutics, contributed next-generation menin inhibitor assets and holds approximately 49.2% following a $50.0 million Series A financing.
Caspian completed a $50.0M Series A; Kura invested $4.3M and owns ~49.2% of Caspian’s outstanding capital.
Kura contributed KO-7246 and related IP to Caspian in exchange for Caspian common stock and up to $1.5M reimbursement.
Caspian is solely responsible for development, regulatory and commercialization in diabetes and cardiometabolic diseases.
Kura and Caspian granted each other non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free perpetual licenses and agreed on limited field restrictions; they also signed an intercompany services agreement.
